## Walkthrough
Replaced version-gated host-call index selection with fixed constants across jam-host-calls, with a special update in Checkpoint. Added accumulationQueue serialization. Unified ServiceAccountInfo Codec across versions. Added preimage length check and gas handling in accumulate; simplified deferred transfers gating and argument encoding. Updated a test runner ignore list.

## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor Accumulator
  participant PVM as PVM
  participant Logger
  note over Accumulator,PVM: Accumulate invocation (updated)

  Accumulator->>PVM: invoke(preimage, gas, regs)
  alt preimage length > W_C
    PVM->>Logger: log("PreimageTooLong")
    PVM-->>Accumulator: Err(PreimageTooLong)
    note right of Accumulator: consumedGas = 0n
  else valid preimage
    PVM-->>Accumulator: Ok(result)
  end
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor AccumulateLoop as Accumulate Loop
  participant Service as Service Code
  participant Encoder as ARGS_CODEC
  participant Exec as Executor
  participant Logger

  note over AccumulateLoop,Service: Deferred transfers (simplified gating)

  AccumulateLoop->>AccumulateLoop: hasTransfers = transfers.length > 0
  AccumulateLoop->>AccumulateLoop: isCodeCorrect = (code != null) && (code.length <= W_C)
  alt !hasTransfers
    AccumulateLoop->>Logger: log("no transfers")
    AccumulateLoop-->>AccumulateLoop: skip ON_TRANSFER
  else !isCodeCorrect
    AccumulateLoop->>Logger: log("code null or too long")
    AccumulateLoop-->>AccumulateLoop: skip ON_TRANSFER
  else proceed
    AccumulateLoop->>Encoder: encode({timeslot, serviceId, transfersLength})
    Encoder-->>AccumulateLoop: args
    AccumulateLoop->>Exec: execute(Service.ON_TRANSFER, args)
    Exec-->>AccumulateLoop: result
  end
```
